hints: The loop condition has two parts: the OpMode being active, and the yaw being under 90.
Reading the yaw is imu.getRobotYawPitchRollAngles().getYaw(AngleUnit.DEGREES) and it goes both in the condition and in the telemetry line.
Inside the loop: frontLeft -0.3, frontRight 0.3, backLeft -0.3, backRight 0.3, then the telemetry lines. Four setPower(0) lines go after the loop.
